title: Ep 55 — Anthropic's hundred-million-dollar Claude academy, Lovable apps learn to talk, and the old-photo colouriser doing five thousand a month
description: Anthropic launches a $100m Claude Frontier Academy to train 10,000 engineers (London included), Lovable adds live voice conversation to no-code apps, GitHub retires four Copilot models, and Microsoft's Digital Defense Report flags browser extensions harvesting AI chat histories. Plus a deep dive on colorize.cc, the Stripe-verified old-photo colouriser clearing about $5,500 a month, niched as a Club Heritage Wall fundraiser, and a correction: Flutter's Cash4Clubs closes 1 January 2027 but only for adult-only groups.
